Title: Office 365, Azure Government Cloud, Resource Manager templates, simplified billing

Body.Content:
We’re announcing:
  • General availability to access Office 365 including Skype for Business. For more information, check out ExpressRoute partners and peering locations.
  • General availability to reach Azure Government Cloud via ExpressRoute. For more information, check out ExpressRoute partners and peering locations.
  • Enablement of Azure Resource Manager with ExpressRoute. Check out the information about templates for samples.
  • Simplified billing model. For more information, see to ExpressRoute Pricing.
